offering_description.value: Operates online auction marketplaces that sell surplus, returned and end-of-life assets for corporate and government sellers. Buyers are businesses and individuals who bid online. It earns fees or sale proceeds by managing sourcing, logistics, valuation and sale of the goods.

primary_products.value: surplus and returned consumer goods; industrial equipment; electronics; vehicles and heavy equipment; government surplus property

primary_services.value: online auction marketplace services; reverse logistics; asset valuation and recovery; remarketing; sourcing and logistics support

customer_segment.value: B2B: Retailers, manufacturers and corporations selling surplus, resellers and businesses buying goods; B2G: Federal, state and local agencies selling surplus and seized assets; B2C: Individual bidders buying surplus goods

end_markets.value: retail and e-commerce returns; government surplus; industrial and manufacturing; aerospace and defense; consumer electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: Sale of inventory purchased outright and resold through auctions; commissions or management fees: Percentage of sale proceeds from consignment and profit-share sales, buyer premiums; service fees: Fees for logistics, valuation and asset management services
revenue_model.category: product sales; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Online marketplaces connecting surplus sellers with buyers; distributor: Buys or takes surplus goods and resells to businesses and consumers; service provider: Provides reverse logistics and asset recovery for corporate and government sellers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom and other European countries, with buyers worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: Marketplaces for retail supply chain, capital assets, government and industrial surplus

distribution_channels.value: online: Auction websites and mobile apps for surplus sales; direct sales: Sales teams sourcing inventory from large retailers and manufacturers; own locations: Warehouses and distribution centers with buyer pickup

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules, some government contract, export, consumer protection and auction rules apply
